topics.name: DWH Index Identity
topics.purpose: Define each DWH index as an explicit derived physical-access structure bound to exact schema/field/expression identities, separate from data and query semantic identities.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant index has an explicit stable index identity.
semantics.type_rule: Index type/profile is explicit where behavior affects compatibility or maintenance.
semantics.physical_rule: Index is a derived physical access structure and not source-of-truth data.
semantics.ownership_rule: Index does not take ownership of indexed data or schema semantics.
semantics.query_rule: Presence/absence of an index never changes canonical query result semantics.
semantics.classification_rule: Index content inherits/protects applicable source classification.
semantics.authority_rule: Index visibility or availability grants no underlying data access.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: index key name used as field semantic identity
